subqueries.query: NVIDIA Data Center revenue growth year over year

hops.query: NVIDIA Data Center revenue growth year over year
hops.rationale: Current scope is NVDA FY2024 10-K (accession 000104581024000029). The requested goal is Data Center revenue growth. E03 states Data Center revenue for fiscal 2024 was $47.5 billion, up 217% from fiscal 2023. E02 repeats that Data Center revenue for fiscal 2024 was up 217%, and E05 gives the underlying figures ($47,525M in FY2024 vs $15,005M in FY2023). The core requested fact is fully supported within scope. The audit prompt's gross margin element is outside the requested_goal and was not graded.
